name: Toy
author: Emilie Gillet
description: A bit-mangled phase ramp read through a sample-and-hold clock that can free-run or lock to the played note.

controls.label: Mangle
controls.description: Sweeps the bit-mangling operand from clean tone to shattered noise.

controls.label: Crush
controls.description: Raises the sample-and-hold rate from a coarse stutter to smooth.

controls.label: Clock
controls.description: Moves the sample-hold clock from free-running to locked to the played note.

controls.label: Fold
controls.description: Biases the fold operand, shifting which harmonics the mangler keeps.

outputs.aux: The same mangler with no reconstruction filter, aliasing intact.
